name: local-dashboard
inputs: Explicit selected run identities and read-only sanitized display projections supplied by the host adapter
Optional external theme preference: system, light or dark; omitted preserves system behavior
outputs: A loopback-only observer URL, cached snapshots, SSE and shared sidebar/PiP presentation
support: Optional host-owned observer with explicit Foundry or target-native adapters. No business dispatch, acceptance, budget or recovery authority. Real task, device and browser acceptance remain separately scoped.
